FROM pm_timesheet ts JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = ts.project_id LEFT JOIN pm_task t ON t.id = ts.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ts.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = ts.approve_by
mapper.select:
SELECT u.nickname AS group_name, p.code AS group_code, p.name AS group_name,
SUM(CASE WHEN ts.status = 'APPROVED' THEN ts.hours ELSE 0 END) AS approved_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN ts.hours ELSE 0 END) AS pending_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.user_id) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.project_id) AS project_count FROM pm_timesheet ts JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = ts.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ts.user_id WHERE ts.status <> 'REJECTED' AND ts.work_date BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND ts.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ts.user_id, u.nicknamets.project_id, p.code, p.name ORDER BY SUM(ts.hours) DESC
